summary: Full backend+frontend testing for FrostGuard Turkish cold-storage monitor. All 9 pytest tests pass (root, warehouses seeded, stats, readings, CRUD, toggle-power, threshold violation, ack-all, AI analyze). Frontend dashboard loads, shows 3 warehouses, all metric blocks, chart, alerts panel, AI insights. Power toggle triggers full-screen red banner ('ELEKTRİK KESİNTİSİ ALGILANDI') and restores correctly. AI 'Analiz Et' returns real Claude Sonnet 4.5 text (927 chars Turkish output). Settings + New Warehouse dialogs open. Ack-all and mute toggles work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~490 lines (acceptable, single-file backend). Simulation engine, models, endpoints could be split into modules if it grows further.

ack_alert returns the alert even after $set acknowledged=True, but does not 404 when modified_count==0; minor — acknowledge of non-existent id silently succeeds until find_one returns None which then 404s. Acceptable.
AI endpoint catches all exceptions and returns a deterministic Turkish fallback summary — good resilience.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: dashboard load, metrics, power toggle + banner, AI analyze, settings dialog, new-warehouse dialog, ack-all)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 warehouses on startup if collection empty. Test created TEST_-prefixed warehouses and cleaned them up via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sim engine tick is 4s; wait ~7-9s after PATCH/toggle-power to verify generated alerts. AI endpoint takes 5-30s. data-testid attributes are comprehensive. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is configured and Claude Sonnet 4.5 integration is live (not mocked).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial test-script timeout on new-warehouse-dialog was due to keyboard Escape from prior settings dialog not fully closing before next click — verified separately that the dialog opens correctly.
